title: Beyond Bass Collapse: New Irregular Edge-Space Invariants in Ihara Theory
summary: Let \(G\) be a finite simple graph and let \(T\) be its Hashimoto operator on the directed-edge space. We show that edge reversal induces a canonical symmetric/antisymmetric splitting under which \(T\) acquires an explicit \(2\times 2\) block form. The diagonal blocks are \(\tfrac12 L(G)\) and \(-\tfrac12 A(G)\), where \(L(G)\) is the line-graph adjacency and \(A(G)\) is the antisymmetric line-graph adjacency, while the off-diagonal block is the mixed incidence product \(M=|D|^\top D\).
